124: 	ash.ctx = ctx
125: 	ash.logger = ctx.Logger()
126: 
127: 	// set some defaults
128: 	if ash.CA == "" {
129: 		ash.CA = caddypki.DefaultCAID
130: 	}
131: 	if ash.PathPrefix == "" {
132: 		ash.PathPrefix = defaultPathPrefix
133: 	}
134: 	if ash.Lifetime == 0 {
135: 		ash.Lifetime = caddy.Duration(12 * time.Hour)
136: 	}
137: 	var acmeChallenges []provisioner.ACMEChallenge
138: 	if len(ash.Challenges) > 0 {
139: 		acmeChallenges = make([]provisioner.ACMEChallenge, 0, len(ash.Challenges))
140: 		for _, ch := range ash.Challenges {
141: 			if err := ch.validate(); err != nil {
142: 				return err
143: 			}
144: 			acmeChallenges = append(acmeChallenges, provisioner.ACMEChallenge(ch))
145: 		}
146: 	}
147: 
148: 	// get a reference to the configured CA
149: 	appModule, err := ctx.App("pki")
150: 	if err != nil {
151: 		return err
152: 	}
153: 	pkiApp := appModule.(*caddypki.PKI)
154: 	ca, ok := pkiApp.CAs[ash.CA]
155: 	if !ok {
156: 		if ash.CA != caddypki.DefaultCAID {
157: 			return fmt.Errorf("no certificate authority configured with id: %s", ash.CA)
158: 		}
159: 		err = pkiApp.ProvisionDefaultCA(ctx)
160: 		if err != nil {
161: 			return fmt.Errorf("failed to provision default CA: %s", err)
162: 		}
163: 		ca = pkiApp.CAs[ash.CA]
164: 	}
165: 
166: 	// make sure leaf cert lifetime is less than the intermediate cert lifetime. this check only
167: 	// applies for caddy-managed intermediate certificates
168: 	if ca.Intermediate == nil && ash.Lifetime >= ca.IntermediateLifetime {
169: 		return fmt.Errorf("certificate lifetime (%s) should be less than intermediate certificate lifetime (%s)", time.Duration(ash.Lifetime), time.Duration(ca.IntermediateLifetime))
170: 	}
171: 
172: 	database, err := ash.openDatabase()
173: 	if err != nil {
174: 		return err
175: 	}
176: 
177: 	var x509Opts *provisioner.X509Options
178: 	if ash.Policy != nil {
179: 		x509Opts = &provisioner.X509Options{
180: 			AllowedNames:       ash.Policy.normalizeAllowRules(),
181: 			DeniedNames:        ash.Policy.normalizeDenyRules(),
182: 			AllowWildcardNames: ash.Policy.AllowWildcardNames,
183: 		}
184: 		if reflect.DeepEqual(x509Opts, &provisioner.X509Options{}) {
185: 			x509Opts = nil
186: 		}
187: 	}
188: 
189: 	authorityConfig := caddypki.AuthorityConfig{
190: 		SignWithRoot: ash.SignWithRoot,
191: 		AuthConfig: &authority.AuthConfig{
192: 			Provisioners: provisioner.List{
193: 				&provisioner.ACME{
194: 					Name:       ash.CA,
195: 					Challenges: acmeChallenges,
196: 					Options: &provisioner.Options{
197: 						X509: x509Opts,
198: 					},
199: 					Type: provisioner.TypeACME.String(),
200: 					Claims: &provisioner.Claims{
201: 						MinTLSDur:     &provisioner.Duration{Duration: 5 * time.Minute},
202: 						MaxTLSDur:     &provisioner.Duration{Duration: 24 * time.Hour * 365},
203: 						DefaultTLSDur: &provisioner.Duration{Duration: time.Duration(ash.Lifetime)},
204: 					},
205: 				},
206: 			},
207: 		},
208: 		DB: database,
209: 	}
210: 
211: 	ash.acmeAuth, err = ca.NewAuthority(authorityConfig)
212: 	if err != nil {
213: 		return err
214: 	}
215: 
216: 	ash.acmeDB, err = acmeNoSQL.New(ash.acmeAuth.GetDatabase().(nosql.DB))
217: 	if err != nil {
218: 		return fmt.Errorf("configuring ACME DB: %v", err)
219: 	}
220: 
221: 	ash.acmeClient, err = ash.makeClient()
222: 	if err != nil {
223: 		return err
224: 	}
225: 
226: 	ash.acmeLinker = acme.NewLinker(
227: 		ash.Host,
228: 		strings.Trim(ash.PathPrefix, "/"),
229: 	)
230: 
231: 	// extract its http.Handler so we can use it directly
232: 	r := chi.NewRouter()
233: 	r.Route(ash.PathPrefix, func(r chi.Router) {
234: 		api.Route(r)
235: 	})
236: 	ash.acmeEndpoints = r
237: 
238: 	return nil
239: }
240: 
241: func (ash Handler) ServeHTTP(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, next caddyhttp.Handler) error {
242: 	if strings.HasPrefix(r.URL.Path, ash.PathPrefix) {
243: 		acmeCtx := acme.NewContext(
244: 			r.Context(),
245: 			ash.acmeDB,
246: 			ash.acmeClient,
247: 			ash.acmeLinker,
248: 			nil,
249: 		)
250: 		acmeCtx = authority.NewContext(acmeCtx, ash.acmeAuth)
251: 		r = r.WithContext(acmeCtx)
252: 
253: 		ash.acmeEndpoints.ServeHTTP(w, r)
254: 		return nil
255: 	}
256: 	return next.ServeHTTP(w, r)
257: }
258: 
259: func (ash Handler) getDatabaseKey() string {
260: 	key := ash.CA
261: 	key = strings.ToLower(key)
262: 	key = strings.TrimSpace(key)
263: 	return keyCleaner.ReplaceAllLiteralString(key, "")
264: }
265: 
266: // Cleanup implements caddy.CleanerUpper and closes any idle databases.
267: func (ash Handler) Cleanup() error {
268: 	key := ash.getDatabaseKey()
269: 	deleted, err := databasePool.Delete(key)
270: 	if deleted {
271: 		ash.logger.Debug("unloading unused CA database", zap.String("db_key", key))
272: 	}
273: 	if err != nil {
274: 		ash.logger.Error("closing CA database", zap.String("db_key", key), zap.Error(err))
275: 	}
276: 	return err
277: }
278: 
279: func (ash Handler) openDatabase() (*db.AuthDB, error) {
280: 	key := ash.getDatabaseKey()
281: 	database, loaded, err := databasePool.LoadOrNew(key, func() (caddy.Destructor, error) {
282: 		dbFolder := filepath.Join(caddy.AppDataDir(), "acme_server", key)
283: 		dbPath := filepath.Join(dbFolder, "db")
284: 
285: 		err := os.MkdirAll(dbFolder, 0o755)
286: 		if err != nil {
287: 			return nil, fmt.Errorf("making folder for CA database: %v", err)
288: 		}
289: 
290: 		dbConfig := &db.Config{
291: 			Type:       "bbolt",
292: 			DataSource: dbPath,
293: 		}
294: 		database, err := db.New(dbConfig)
295: 		return databaseCloser{&database}, err
296: 	})
297: 
298: 	if loaded {
299: 		ash.logger.Debug("loaded preexisting CA database", zap.String("db_key", key))
300: 	}
301: 
302: 	return database.(databaseCloser).DB, err
303: }
304: 
305: // makeClient creates an ACME client which will use a custom
306: // resolver instead of net.DefaultResolver.
307: func (ash Handler) makeClient() (acme.Client, error) {
308: 	for _, v := range ash.Resolvers {
309: 		addr, err := caddy.ParseNetworkAddressWithDefaults(v, "udp", 53)
310: 		if err != nil {
311: 			return nil, err
312: 		}
313: 		if addr.PortRangeSize() != 1 {
314: 			return nil, fmt.Errorf("resolver address must have exactly one address; cannot call %v", addr)
315: 		}
316: 		ash.resolvers = append(ash.resolvers, addr)
317: 	}
318: 
319: 	var resolver *net.Resolver
320: 	if len(ash.resolvers) != 0 {
321: 		dialer := &net.Dialer{
322: 			Timeout: 2 * time.Second,
323: 		}
324: 		resolver = &net.Resolver{
325: 			PreferGo: true,
326: 			Dial: func(ctx context.Context, network, address string) (net.Conn, error) {
327: 				//nolint:gosec
328: 				addr := ash.resolvers[weakrand.Intn(len(ash.resolvers))]
329: 				return dialer.DialContext(ctx, addr.Network, addr.JoinHostPort(0))
330: 			},
331: 		}
332: 	} else {
333: 		resolver = net.DefaultResolver
334: 	}
335: 
336: 	return resolverClient{
337: 		Client:   acme.NewClient(),
338: 		resolver: resolver,
339: 		ctx:      ash.ctx,
340: 	}, nil
341: }
342: 
343: type resolverClient struct {
344: 	acme.Client
345: 
346: 	resolver *net.Resolver
347: 	ctx      context.Context
348: }
349: 
350: func (c resolverClient) LookupTxt(name string) ([]string, error) {
351: 	return c.resolver.LookupTXT(c.ctx, name)
352: }
353: 
354: const defaultPathPrefix = "/acme/"
355: 
356: var (
357: 	keyCleaner   = regexp.MustCompile(`[^\w.-_]`)
358: 	databasePool = caddy.NewUsagePool()
359: )
360: 
361: type databaseCloser struct {
362: 	DB *db.AuthDB
363: }
364: 
365: func (closer databaseCloser) Destruct() error {
366: 	return (*closer.DB).Shutdown()
367: }
368:

370: var (
371: 	_ caddyhttp.MiddlewareHandler = (*Handler)(nil)
372: 	_ caddy.Provisioner           = (*Handler)(nil)
373: )
